statements.status_notes: Alpine 3.24 builds rsyslog with omhttp enabled but does not enable or ship the optional contrib/imhttp module that CVE-2026-55556 affects; the vulnerable Basic-auth parsing path is not present in this APK. Advisory: https://github.com/rsyslog/rsyslog/security/advisories/GHSA-947w-69ph-mc2r

The DHI rsyslog APK backports the upstream replace() sizing rewind fix from https://github.com/rsyslog/rsyslog/commit/667e3f61aec5ee02c5c2ee6f0f8accf6fe4301a9 so the sizing and copy passes agree on partial-match rewind. Advisory: https://github.com/rsyslog/rsyslog/security/advisories/GHSA-g72f-gc6v-f2w3
